title: VSift audio data v1
description: The data member of a complete or partial audio result (P09, ADR 0019): one WAV clip of at most 30 s of the session's audio (16 kHz mono signed 16-bit, decision D5). request is the requested half-open range; a range that runs past the end of the source is clipped to it and range_clipped is true. The single selection has role requested, requested_us the requested start, actual_us the first decoded sample's time and delta_us their difference. items holds the audio_evidence record, files delivers the clip as the absolute path of the committed session artifact, valid while the session exists (decision D2). With reused true the record was committed by an identical earlier request and returned without running a provider or writing anything. Times are integer microseconds on the normalized source timeline.

range_clipped.description: true when the requested range ran past the end of the source and the clip covers only its part before the end.
